items.label: text
items.text: The direction of the magnetic field depends upon the direction of the current.It can be found using the righthand grip rule (for fields).

items.label: text
items.text: Ifweplace an object made froma magnetic material,for example,an iron nail, inside a magneticfield it becomesa magnet.We say that magnetism hasbeen induced in the nail.Because iron is amagnetically soft material,its induced magnetism is temporary and disappearsif the permanentmagnet isremoved. If thenail ismade from a magnetically hard material such assteel itwillretain someofitsmagnetismafter themagnetisremoved.

items.label: text
items.text: When there isa current in awirea magneticfieldiscreated around it.Thisis called electromagnetism.The fieldaround the wire isquite weakand circularin shape.

items.label: text
items.text: The shape and direction of the magnetic field around a current-carrying wire can be seen using iron filings and plotting compasses.

items.label: text
items.text: Changing the direction of the curent,changes the direction of the magnetic field.

items.text: Figure 20.9 A current-carying wire has amagnetic field around it.

items.label: caption
items.text: With the thumb of your right hand pointing in the direction of the current,yourfingers will curl in the direction of the field.
